name: Jean Brachet
summary: Belgian embryologist and founding father of molecular biology known for chemical embryology and RNA research.

name: Albert Brachet
summary: Founder of the Brussels school of embryology and father of Jean Brachet.

name: Albert Dalcq
summary: Successor of Albert Brachet and collaborator with Jean Pasteels on morphogenetic gradients.

name: Jean Pasteels
summary: Collaborator of Albert Dalcq known for work on embryonic induction and morphogenetic potential.

name: Joseph Needham
summary: British biochemist and father of chemical embryology who collaborated with Jean Brachet.

name: C. Waddington
summary: British developmental biologist who collaborated on the nature of the amphibian organiser.

name: Université Libre de Bruxelles
summary: University where Albert Brachet held the Chair of Anatomy and founded the embryology school.

name: Embryologie Chimique
summary: Book by Jean Brachet published in 1944 on chemical embryology.

name: The Biochemistry of Development
summary: Book by Jean Brachet published in 1960.
